279369720.description:
Mineral Identification Collection Kit
Geological Specimen Study Set
8 Natural Mineral Samples in Display Box
8" x 6" x 2"
Numbered Collection
This professional mineral identification kit is an essential resource for geological education and scientific observation. The collection consists of eight distinct natural mineral specimens, including recognizable samples such as crystalline quartz, pink feldspar, and metallic pyrite. Each sample is individually numbered, allowing for systematic classification and study of physical properties such as luster, crystal habit, and cleavage.
Features 8 high-quality natural specimens housed in a 9-compartment white plastic organizer
Housed in a durable red textured storage case with a protective foam-lined interior lid
Provides a hands-on learning experience for students, hobbyists, and amateur geologists
Condition:

Description
: Add a unique touch to your collection or decor with this 3.9kg polished petrified wood display specimen. Featuring a combination of glossy black with natural tan and brown streaks, this eye-catching piece reveals the striking transformation from wood to stone over millions of years. The front and sides display a mirror-like polish, highlighting the vibrant fossilized patterns, while the back and edges retain the natural stone texture, providing both visual and tactile contrast.
Perfect as a focal point for your shelf, office, or study, this petrified wood specimen offers a blend of ancient natural beauty and modern appeal. Its sturdy form and weight allow it to stand upright for easy display, while the polished surfaces make it easy to maintain and appreciate. Please note minor edge wear is visible, but these do not detract from the overall polished appearance and charm. Ideal for collectors, geology enthusiasts, or as a natural decor accent
